name: HeyGen
summary: AI video platform that turns scripts, photos and audio into avatar-narrated videos and translates them into 175+ languages.
description: Web platform for creating AI videos at scale: generate presenter videos from a script, a photo or an audio file using AI avatars, voice cloning and lip sync, with an AI Studio script-based editor and a Video Agent that turns a prompt into a finished video. It also translates and dubs existing videos into 175+ languages, and ships an enterprise API, MCP server and developer portal.
contains: avatars from a photo or a 15-second video (Avatar IV and Avatar V)
developer portal with API, SDK, CLI, MCP and webhooks
free plan: 3 videos per month; Creator from $29/mo
